title: will be doing and will have done

data.en: These people are standing in a queue to get into the cinema.
data.cn: 这些人在排队进电影院。
data.hint: These +复数名词 | 现在进行时结构

data.en: Half an hour from now, the cinema will be full.
data.cn: 半小时后，电影院将挤满人。
data.hint: Half an hour from now | 将来时表达

data.en: Everyone will be watching the film.
data.cn: 每个人都会在看电影。
data.hint: Everyone +单数谓语 | 将来进行时

data.en: Three hours from now, the cinema will be empty.
data.cn: 三小时后，电影院将空无一人。
data.hint: Three hours from now | 时间状语

data.en: The film will have finished.
data.cn: 电影将已经结束。
data.hint: will have +过去分词 | 将来完成时

data.en: Everyone will have gone home.
data.cn: 大家都会已经回家了。
data.hint: gone home | 将来完成时动作

data.en: This time next week I'll be on holiday.
data.cn: 下周这个时候我将在度假。
data.hint: This time next week | 将来时间状语

data.en: I'll be lying on the beach or swimming in the sea.
data.cn: 我将在沙滩上躺着或者在海里游泳。
data.hint: lying / swimming | 并列的将来进行时

data.en: You have no chance of getting the job.
data.cn: 你没有机会得到这份工作。
data.hint: no chance of | 固定搭配

data.en: You'll be wasting your time if you apply.
data.cn: 如果你申请的话就是在浪费时间。
data.hint: if 条件状语从句 | 将来进行时

data.en: Don't phone between 7 and 8.
data.cn: 7点到8点之间不要打电话。
data.hint: Don't +动词原形 | 否定祈使句

data.en: We'll be eating.
data.cn: 我们会在吃饭。
data.hint: We'll be eating | 将来进行时

data.en: Let's wait for Liz to arrive and then we'll eat.
data.cn: 我们等莉兹到了再吃吧。
data.hint: Let's +动词原形 | 建议句型

data.en: The government will be making a statement about the crisis later today.
data.cn: 政府将于今天晚些时候就这场危机发表声明。
data.hint: will be making | 将来动作安排

data.en: Later in the programme, I'll be talking to the Minister of Education.
data.cn: 在节目的后期，我将与教育大臣交谈。
data.hint: Later in the programme | 时间状语

data.en: The team's star player is injured and won't be playing in the game on Saturday.
data.cn: 球队的明星球员受伤了，将不会参加周六的比赛。
data.hint: won't be playing | 否定将来进行时

data.en: Sally always leaves for work at 8.30 in the morning.
data.cn: 萨莉总是早上8点30分出门上班。
data.hint: leaves for | 动词短语

data.en: She won't be at home at 9 o'clock – she'll have gone to work.
data.cn: 9点钟她不在家——她已经去上班了。
data.hint: she'll have gone | 将来完成时

data.en: We're late.
data.cn: 我们迟到了。
data.hint: We are 缩写 | 主系表结构

data.en: The film will already have started by the time we get to the cinema.
data.cn: 当我们到达电影院时，电影已经开始了。
data.hint: by the time引导时间状语从句 | 将来完成时

data.en: Ted and Amy have been married for 24 years.
data.cn: 泰德和艾米结婚已经24年了。
data.hint: have been married | 现在完成时

data.en: Next year they will have been married for 25 years.
data.cn: 到明年他们就结婚满25年了。
data.hint: Next year | 将来完成时标志

data.en: When their son was born, they had been married for three years.
data.cn: （当时）他们的儿子出生时，他们已经结婚三年了。
data.hint: had been married | 过去完成时

data.en: Andy goes to work every day.
data.cn: 安迪每天去上班。
data.hint: goes to work | 一般现在时

data.en: He leaves home at 8 o'clock and arrives at work at about 8.45.
data.cn: 他8点离开家，大约8点45分到达工作地点。
data.hint: leaves / arrives | 并列一般现在时

data.en: He starts work immediately and continues until 12.30.
data.cn: 他立即开始工作并一直持续到12点30分。
data.hint: until 12.30 | 时间介词短语

data.en: He starts work again at 1.15 and goes home at exactly 4.30.
data.cn: 他在1点15分再次开始工作，并准确在4点30分回家。
data.hint: at exactly 4.30 | 精确时间表达

data.en: Every day he follows the same routine and tomorrow will be no exception.
data.cn: 他每天都遵循相同的作息，明天也不会例外。
data.hint: will be no exception | 将来时态

data.en: There's an election next week.
data.cn: 下周有一场选举。
data.hint: There is 缩写 | 存在句型

data.en: Who will you be voting for?
data.cn: 你将投票支持谁？
data.hint: Who ... for | 特殊疑问句

data.en: I'll be going shopping later.
data.cn: 我待会儿要去购物。
data.hint: I'll be going | 将来进行时

data.en: Can I get you anything?
data.cn: 我能给你带点什么吗？
data.hint: Can I ...? | 征求意见句型

data.en: Emily is not well, so she won't be playing volleyball tomorrow.
data.cn: 艾米身体不太舒服，所以她明天不会打排球。
data.hint: won't be playing | 否定将来进行时

data.en: Little Emma will be starting school soon.
data.cn: 小埃玛很快就要上学了。
data.hint: will be starting | 将来进行时/安排

data.en: She's growing up fast.
data.cn: 她长得真快。
data.hint: She is 缩写 | 现在进行时表变化

data.en: The match is on TV tonight.
data.cn: 今晚电视上有这场比赛。
data.hint: on TV tonight | 时间与地点介词短语

data.en: Will you be watching it?
data.cn: 你会看吗？
data.hint: Will you be ...? | 将来进行时一般疑问句

data.en: What will you be doing in your new job?
data.cn: 你在新工作里会做什么？
data.hint: What ... doing | 特殊疑问句

data.en: I won't be going to the wedding.
data.cn: 我不会去参加婚礼。
data.hint: won't be going | 否定将来进行时

data.en: I'll be away on holiday.
data.cn: 我将外出度假。
data.hint: away on holiday | 固定短语

data.en: Please fasten your seat belts.
data.cn: 请系好安全带。
data.hint: fasten your seat belts | 祈使句

data.en: The plane will be landing in ten minutes.
data.cn: 飞机将在十分钟内降落。
data.hint: will be landing | 将来进行时

data.en: Tomorrow afternoon we're going to play tennis from 3 o'clock until 4.30.
data.cn: 明天下午我们将从3点到4点30分打网球。
data.hint: from 3 o'clock until 4.30 | 时间段

data.en: So at 4 o'clock, we'll be playing tennis.
data.cn: 所以在4点钟，我们将会在打网球。
data.hint: we'll be playing | 将来进行时

data.en: Sarah will meet you at the station.
data.cn: 萨拉会在车站接你。
data.hint: will meet | 一般将来时

data.en: She'll be waiting for you when you arrive.
data.cn: 当你到达时，她会在那里等你。
data.hint: She'll be waiting | 将来进行时

data.en: The meeting starts at 9.30 and won't last longer than an hour.
data.cn: 会议9点30分开始，持续时间不会超过一个小时。
data.hint: won't last longer | 否定将来时

data.en: You can be sure that it will have finished by 11 o'clock.
data.cn: 你可以确信它在11点之前就已经结束了。
data.hint: will have finished | 将来完成时

data.en: Do you think you'll still be living in the same place in ten years' time?
data.cn: 你认为十年后你还会住在同一个地方吗？
data.hint: Do you think ...? | 一般疑问句

data.en: Lisa is travelling in Europe and so far she has travelled about 1,000 miles.
data.cn: 丽莎正在欧洲旅行，到目前为止她已经旅行了大约1000英里。
data.hint: has travelled | 现在完成时
